name: 050.4 — the docs teach the catalogue
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 050.4: every permission key the reference now prints -- in the guide's catalogue table and again beside its verb on the page that owns it -- is driven through the gate, so a key the docs invented, misspelled or drifted onto the wrong verb reddens a line naming its page. It also checks the guide's group table against the grouping the engine's own refusals reveal. It declares no permissions: every check is a refusal, so nothing is sent.
